description.p: Hermitage is a single-user, local-first media sanctuary for your Calibre library. It opens your existing Calibre database read-only and renders the library as an edge-to-edge cover-art grid with a sliding detail pane, a tag-tree genre browser, a series browser, and an at-a-glance Library Insights window.

ul.li: Cover-art grid with per-cover dynamic colour glow
Codex detail view with hero-blur header, ISBN/Goodreads/etc. links
Genre browser using Calibre's dot-separated tag hierarchy
Calibre-compatible search query language with virtual library support
Local reading history (recent shelf, read indicator, last-opened line)
Library Insights — top tags/authors, format coverage, hygiene audit
Bundled premium typography (Fraunces, Inter, IBM Plex Sans Condensed)
100% local — zero telemetry, zero accounts, zero network calls

description.p: Library export to JSON or CSV; toast notification system.
Library Insights window — at-a-glance counters, top tags/authors, format coverage, library hygiene audit.
Series browser sibling to the genre browser.
Identifier links in the Codex (Open Library, Goodreads, Google Books, Amazon, StoryGraph, Hardcover, FictionDB, DOI, …) plus tag-hierarchy search parity with cquarry.
Reading history — local SQLite event log, Codex "Last read" line, grid read indicator, "Recently Read" virtual library row.
Phase 7 complete: empty states, error resilience, and the database-lock snapshot fallback.
